consolidation_recommendation.headline: Move from 20 scattered .env files to 1 master + thin per-service includes (75% reduction in secret-rotation surface)
steps: 1. Adopt /home/tagai/.tagai-env as the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for tagai-user-level secrets (Anthropic, Supabase, MS, Telnyx, etc.)
2. Adopt /home/tagai/.openclaw/.env as the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for container-internal secrets
3. Replace each service-scoped .env with a 1-line `set -a; source /home/tagai/.tagai-env; set +a` include OR symlink the master file
4. Move /home/tagai/.openclaw/secrets/*.token contents INTO the master env files — having two parallel secret stores doubles rotation work
6. Audit /opt/voiceai/server/.env and /opt/michelle-cma/.env — both empty, indicating dead services OR env injected via systemd unit
7. Establish quarterly rotation cadence for the top-3-duplicate keys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, MS_CLIENT_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY
8. Move all keys into 1Password vault as canonical store; sync to VPS via a single bootstrap script that writes /home/tagai/.tagai-env and /home/tagai/.openclaw/.env
consolidation_recommendation.rotation_burden_before: Rotate Anthropic key = update 4 files. Rotate MS_CLIENT_SECRET = update 4 files. Rotate Resend = update 5 files.
consolidation_recommendation.rotation_burden_after: Rotate any key = update 1 file (1Password) + run bootstrap script.
